summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 requested bug fixes on the Laravel 12 + Inertia + Vue 3 app (https://laravel-workspace.preview.emergentagent.com). All 3 fixes VERIFIED WORKING via real browser interaction. BUG 1C (register wizard step gating): buyer flow - clicking 'Devam et' with empty step-1 fields does NOT advance and shows 4 inline red errors (Ad Soyad/Kullanıcı adı/E-posta/GSM zorunludur) plus is-invalid borders; after valid values it advances to 'Adım 2 / 2' password step. Seller flow - selecting 'Satıcı' + valid step-1 advances to 'Adım 2 / 3 Satıcı Doğrulama'; empty step-2 next blocked with errors for Vergi Numarası, IBAN, Kimlik Belgesi; short IBAN 'TR12345' blocked with 'IBAN 26-34 karakter arası olmalıdır.'; missing id document blocked; after valid tax no + 26-char IBAN + uploaded file it advances to 'Adım 3 / 3'. BUG 1B (login): all required elements present (login-email, login-password, google-login-button, login-submit, 'Beni Hatırla' checkbox toggles False->True, 'Şifremi unuttum?' link); buyer@test.com/password login succeeded and redirected to /dashboard with data loaded (balance, 7 aktif teklif, 4 favori). BUG 1A (header placeholder): #mhdr-input placeholder text 'Müzayede, ilan veya kullanıcı ara...' renders with computed ::placeholder color rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65), opacity 1, visibility visible; homepage filter-bar input shows 'Artırma ara...' with same color; NO horizontal overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth 1920 == window.innerWidth 1920, zero offending elements).

integration_issues.issue: Placeholder promises 'Müzayede, ilan veya kullanıcı ara...' but /live-search only returns USERS. Query 'vazo' returns [] and shows 'Sonuç bulunamadı.' even though multiple auctions contain 'Vazo' in the title ('Mavi-Beyaz Çini Vazo Üçlüsü', 'Bordo Altın Detaylı Porselen Vazo'). Either include auctions in results or change the placeholder. Not part of the 3 fixes - informational.

issues: Step 1 has no progress bar / step label ('Adım 1 / 2|3') while steps 2 and 3 do - minor visual inconsistency

action_items: Optional: make header live-search include auctions/listings or reword the placeholder to 'Kullanıcı ara...'
Optional: add an 'Adım 1 / N' progress header to register step 1 for consistency
critical_code_review_comments: Register.vue client validation (validateStep1/validateStep2) matches server rules in RegisteredUserController (username regex/length, IBAN 26-34, required tax_number/id_document) - gating logic is correct and blocks step advance via early return in goStep1Next/goStep2Next.
Vite production build (public/build/manifest.json, 23:06) is newer than the modified .vue sources (23:05) so the fixes are actually served - no rebuild needed.
seed_data_creation: None. No registration was submitted (stopped at password step), no test users created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only GRUP-1 pages (/, /login, /register) were tested per request. Register wizard gating, login flow and header/index placeholder visibility all pass. Untested: register form actual submission (POST /register), seller/admin dashboards, GRUP 3/5/6/7 pages. Known unrelated: some /storage/auctions/*.jpg return 403 -> cards show 'Görsel bulunamadı' placeholders; header live-search returns users only.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all three reported bugs are fixed and verified in the live preview build.
